# Alder Tree Therapy

> Alder Tree Therapy LCSW PLLC is the private psychotherapy practice of Tanya Fridland, LCSW, a New York licensed clinical social worker and former BigLaw attorney. She provides individual telehealth psychotherapy to adults located anywhere in New York State. Her focus is working parents balancing a demanding career with family, and professionals with ADHD in demanding jobs.

## Key facts
- Clinician: Tanya Fridland, LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker, New York State)
- Education: MSW, Columbia University School of Social Work (Advanced Clinical Social Work Practice); JD, Harvard Law School
- Background: Former BigLaw attorney in New York City
- Format: Individual psychotherapy for adults, by video (telehealth)
- Service area: Clients located anywhere in New York State
- Scheduling: Flexible rescheduling on short notice
- Primary focus: Working parents in demanding careers; adults with ADHD and executive functioning challenges at work, including those diagnosed in adulthood or exploring whether ADHD fits
- Also works with: Burnout, anxiety, depression, chronic pain, social anxiety, relationship difficulties, life transitions
- Approach: Collaborative, strengths-based, and practical. Integrates Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT), and executive functioning strategies. Combines teaching executive functioning skills and strategies with therapy, addressing the practical and emotional sides of ADHD together.
- Does not prescribe medication. With client permission and a signed HIPAA release, coordinates care with the client’s prescriber.
- Insurance: Out-of-network provider; does not bill insurance directly. Helps clients verify out-of-network benefits, provides superbills for reimbursement, and uses Reimbursify to streamline submitting superbills to insurance.
- Booking: Free consultation at https://aldertreetherapy.janeapp.com
- Email: tanya@aldertreetherapy.com
